ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a stepped solid after a cuboid has had one piece cut away. The bottom edge is labeled 12, the left-side depth is labeled 6, and the total height on the right side is labeled 8. After cutting, the height of the lower part on the left is labeled 5, and the retained higher part on the right is labeled 3 along the length direction. The dashed lines indicate the upper outline of the original complete cuboid and the rectangular part that was cut away. Reasoning: From the figure, the dimensions of the original cuboid are read as 12 × 6 × 8. After cutting, the height of the lower platform is 5, and the length of the higher part on the right is 3, so the dimensions of the upper-left cuboid that was cut away are (12 − 3) × 6 × (8 − 5) = 9 × 6 × 3. The surface area of the original cuboid is 2(12×6 + 12×8 + 6×8) = 2(72 + 96 + 48) = 432. Add the areas of the faces for the remaining stepped solid surface area: bottom face 12×6 = 72; total horizontal top face area is 9×6 + 3×6 = 72; each of the front and back stepped side faces is 9×5 + 3×8 = 69, so together 138; left side face is 6×5 = 30; right side face is 6×8 = 48; middle vertical step face is 6×3 = 18. Therefore the remaining surface area is 72 + 72 + 138 + 30 + 48 + 18 = 378. The decrease in surface area is 432 − 378 = 54. The percentage decrease is 54/432 × 100% = 12.5%.

raw_record.question_text: A rectangular section was cut out of a rectangular block as shown in the diagram. Find the decrease percentage of the surface area.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram as an original rectangular prism with dimensions 12 by 6 by 8. The cut leaves a lower part of height 5 and a right raised part of length 3, so the removed top-left section has length 12−3=9, depth 6, and height 8−5=3. Compute the original surface area as 2(12·6+12·8+6·8). Then compute the surface area of the remaining stepped solid by summing visible types of faces: bottom 12·6, total horizontal top area 9·6+3·6, two stepped front/back faces each 9·5+3·8, the left side 6·5, the right side 6·8, and the vertical step face 6·3. Compare final surface area with original and divide the decrease by the original surface area to get the percentage.

图像描述：图中是一个长方体被切去一块后的阶梯形立体。底边标为 12，左侧深度标为 6，右侧总高度标为 8。切割后左侧较低部分的高度标为 5，右侧保留的较高部分沿长度方向标为 3。虚线表示原来完整长方体的上部轮廓和被切去的矩形部分。

推理：按图读出原长方体尺寸为 12 × 6 × 8。切割后，下方低平台高度为 5，右侧高出部分长度为 3，所以被切去的上方左侧长方体尺寸为 (12 − 3) × 6 × (8 − 5) = 9 × 6 × 3。
原长方体表面积为 2(12×6 + 12×8 + 6×8) = 2(72 + 96 + 48) = 432。
剩余阶梯形立体表面积按面相加：底面 12×6 = 72；水平顶面总面积为 9×6 + 3×6 = 72；前后两个阶梯侧面各为 9×5 + 3×8 = 69，所以共 138；左侧面为 6×5 = 30；右侧面为 6×8 = 48；中间竖直台阶面为 6×3 = 18。因此剩余表面积为 72 + 72 + 138 + 30 + 48 + 18 = 378。
表面积减少量为 432 − 378 = 54。减少百分比为 54/432 × 100% = 12.5%。
